models_evaluated: commercial AI-based lung nodule detection/classification tool integrated in PACS

links.outcome: Interpretation time, nodule detection rates, follow-up recommendations, and lung cancer diagnoses with vs without AI in randomized trial
links.effect: No significant difference in interpretation time (187 vs 172 s, p=.23); higher Lung-RADS-positive detection (16.9% vs 10.3%), all-nodule detection (52.9% vs 32.6%), follow-up LDCT recommendations (15.3% vs 7.4%); no lung cancers diagnosed in either group.
links.quote: Use of an AI-based nodule evaluation tool integrated into PACS during real-world clinical workflows was not associated with a significant difference in interpretation times.

screen.reason: This prospective randomized controlled trial evaluates the real-world deployment of a PACS-integrated commercial AI nodule detection tool compared to standard unassisted radiologist interpretation, assessing workflow time and clinical detection rates.
